"Do it without dues." There maybe legal challenges but woof. At best? An abject fail in Amazon union messaging. At worst? Kinda racist.

The warehouse maybe be overwhelmingly 'bama Black - 85% - but that doesn't mean #BlackLivesMatter was a winning message

Fun Easter egg in the story ... the alternate juror wonders if a Black male witness is wearing a "#BlackLivesMatter " t-shirt under his dress white shirt.

It's the only sartorial analysis she gives in her 18 pages of notes and two plus months of jury duty.
